description: Header file defining the NuMediaExtractor class, which provides media extraction functionalities within the Android media framework. It declares methods for setting data sources, retrieving track info, seeking, reading samples, and managing tracks.

classes.name: NuMediaExtractor
classes.description: Main class for media extraction, providing interfaces for setting data sources, track management, seeking, and sample reading.

methods.name: setDataSource
methods.description: Sets the data source for media extraction, either via HTTP, file descriptor, or DataSource object.

methods.name: getTrackFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the format information for a specific track.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp within the media.

methods.name: readSampleData
methods.description: Reads sample data into a provided buffer.
